notes.title: Planaris 2+ Version 1.1 Released
notes.notes:
I've just released the first update for Planaris 2+, version 1.1! 

The major new features are:
[list]
[*] Controller support! You can now play the game with a controller in Steam Big Picture Mode... There are official bindings for both the Dualshock 4 and the Steam Controller, and other controllers should work as-well as long as you set the appropriate bindings in steam (or load community bindings setup by someone else). If you want to play the game with a controller, I'd recommend doing the tutorial again first (by selecting it from campaign mode) to learn the basics.
[*] 4 New levels added to campaign mode... Get those stars!
[/list]

Some minor changes/tweaks include:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Dedication achievement being improperly awarded.
[*] You can now navigate the menus with your keyboard.
[*] Made one of the songs that plays during gameplay a bit longer... to reduce repetitiveness.
[/list]

That's it for now... As always, if you have any feedback or find any bugs, head on over to the community forum and let me know!
